separateFromMatches.description: With newTitle: add it as a separate book although the catalogue has possible matches. Without it, possible matches refuse the request with title_match.

color.description: A highlight colour name, for a highlight or a note on selected text (ADR-0094). Absent is the default look; each client picks the shade it draws.

biography.description: Empty when the provider has none.

detail.description: A short line to tell people of the same name apart.

url.description: The record on the provider's site.

version.description: Changes with every new image; null without one.

medium.description: What to open: the one used most recently, or the ebook of an unread title.

isbn.description: ISBN-10 or ISBN-13; hyphens and spaces are removed.

location.description: Where the copy is kept, in the owner's words.

note.description: Everyone who can see the copy sees it.

source.description: Default url; search when the address came from a search result.

url.description: A public http or https address.

searchEnabled.description: Whether the server may query Open Library and iTunes for covers.

photo.description: Authors only: also store the candidate's photo.

coverTitleId.description: A title of this author whose cover can stand for them.

lastName.description: The last name used for sorting and letters: a saved correction, or a guess.

photoVersion.description: Set when the author has a stored photo; changes with it.

seriesCount.description: How many series this author's visible titles belong to.

letters.description: The A to Z letters with authors matching the search under this sort.

medium.description: Which cover to show: the ebook one when the caller can see an ebook.

match.description: Series only: the matched provider record.

provider.description: Set for a value applied from a provider.

source.description: user is a saved edit, guessed is derived from the name, none has no value.

fresh.description: Ignore results cached from the last few minutes.

authors.description: Up to three first authors of the series' titles.

coverTitleId.description: The earliest title in series order.

covers.description: Up to five titles in series order, for a stack of covers.

finished.description: How many of the visible titles the caller has finished.

apiVersion.description: The full API version, for example 1.2.0 or 1.0.0-development.

suffixed.description: The target name was changed to avoid overwriting an existing file.

autoFillTitleMatch.description: Lets Auto-fill propose one clear title-and-author match when a book has no identifier (ADR-0090). Off by default.

sentinelPath.description: Operator-supplied root identity file, relative to the root; never created automatically.

listenedSeconds.description: Wall-clock seconds during which audio played; playback speed does not change it.

clear.description: With action set: store a deliberate clear (value must be null).

value.description: With action set and clear false: the new value.
Absent when the field was deliberately cleared.

coverVersion.description: Set when a cover is stored.

url.description: The book on the provider's site; empty when unknown.

source.description: user: the result of the person's own action. system: background work they did not start.

enabled.description: The library has at least one metadata provider turned on.

sameIsbn.description: An ebook or paper copy of it has this ISBN. Otherwise the name and first author match.

isbn.description: ISBN-10 or ISBN-13; hyphens and spaces are removed.

location.description: Where the copy is kept, in the owner's words.

note.description: Everyone who can see the copy sees it.

sourcePath.description: Absolute directory on the server; read-only and never modified.

changes.description: Fields to write: title, authors, series_name, series_index, narrators, publisher, published, isbn, description. An EPUB cannot hold narrators or a page count.

providers.description: Search only these providers, which must also be enabled for the library. Omit to search every enabled provider.

activeSeconds.description: Seconds the person was actively reading, not the length of the window.

activity.description: Every day with reading or listening.

books.description: Distinct titles read in the range.

listenedBooks.description: Distinct titles listened to in the range.

paperBooksFinished.description: Distinct titles whose paper copy was marked finished in the range.

description.description: Empty when the provider has none.

matchedBooks.description: How many of the books searched point at this series.

numberedBooks.description: Whole-numbered main books the provider lists.

filter.description: For a smart shelf, a filter in the library search format; null for a manual shelf.

verify.description: Also re-hash every file to detect changed bytes with unchanged size and time.

field.description: For a rule: what to test.

join.description: For a group: how its rules combine.

operator.description: For a rule; which operators a field accepts is checked by the server.

rules.description: For a group: its rules and nested groups.

value.description: A string, a number, a boolean or a list of up to 20 strings, by field and operator.

ratingHalves.description: Half stars, 1 (half a star) to 10 (five stars); null is unrated.

review.description: Private to the author; empty is no review.

addedAt.description: When the title first appeared in a granted library.

formats.description: Ebook formats such as epub or pdf, audio when there is a recording and paper when there is a paper copy.

libraryIds.description: Granted libraries that hold the title.

ratingHalves.description: The caller's own rating in half stars.

q.description: Literal substring over title, authors and series, applied in addition to the tree.

info.description: Litara client API, major version 1 (development). Within a major version only additive change is made (ADR-0082): ignore unknown response properties and unknown enum values.
